name: TemporaryWorksRegister
tagline: Temporary works procedure in one Power Apps component – categories, checks, inspections and permits to load and strike.
description: A complete temporary works register for construction: briefs and designers, design check categories 0-3 with checker independence, check certificates, erection and periodic inspections, permits to load and strike with strike readiness by concrete strength or minimum days, a procedure board with drag and drop and readiness issues for late, overdue and non-compliant items. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Check categories 0-3 with project minimums per type
Checker independence (Cat 2 confirmation, Cat 3 independent organisation)
Erection and periodic inspections with pass / actions / fail
Permit to load and permit to strike with permit text
Strike readiness by strength or minimum days
Drag-and-drop procedure board with rule checks
Bulk steps, inspections and TWS assignment with undo
